products.description: Located in Gwangju (Dong-Gu), Backpack Season 2 Guesthouse - Hostel is within a 15-minute walk of Nine Gallery and Gwangju Art Street. Featured amenities include microwave in a common area, refrigerator in a common area, and a water dispenser. Guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle for a surcharge, and free self parking is available onsite.
